Name: Kaprun Main Stage
note: English-language twin of the Kaprun Hauptstufe (Verbund; 220 MW turbine capacity per https://de.wikipedia.org/wiki/Kraftwerksgruppe_Kaprun); the German entry is kept and corrected to 220 MW

Name: Malta Main Stage
note: English-language twin of the Malta Hauptstufe pumped-storage plant (730 MW; https://www.verbund.com/de-at/ueber-verbund/kraftwerke/unsere-kraftwerke/malta-hauptstufe) with no Technology and coordinates at the Koelnbrein dam; the E-Control Anlagenregister lists the plant three times as well

Name: Feldkirchen
note: VERBUND Innkraftwerk Feldkirchen at Rott am Inn/Schechen, Bavaria, 38.2 MW run-of-river, 1970 (https://de.wikipedia.org/wiki/Kraftwerk_Feldkirchen); powerplantmatching lists it a second time as an Austrian plant without technology, geocoded into the Moelltal (46.86 N 13.34 E); the German entry (DE2, 38.2 MW, correct coordinates) is kept, so the Austrian twin is dropped rather than relocated
